requirements: Sellers create listings with a status and a price; a listing's seller never changes. Every signed-in user sees active listings; sellers also see and edit their own listings whatever the status. Buyers place orders on listings and see only their own orders. Nothing is deleted.
expected_properties: A listing is visible only when active or to its seller.
An order is visible only to its buyer.
Only the seller changes a listing.
Whatever is written can be read back.
The application role may only select/insert/update listings and select/insert orders.
